findings.title: Booking invites accept arbitrary emails and inject MemberInbox + email + push with no community membership check
evidence: createBookingInvites maps invites without emailBelongsToCommunity / same-community check
addMemberInboxItem({ userEmail: email }) for each invitee (cross-tenant inbox write)
sendEmail + sendPushToUser to arbitrary addresses with club-branded copy and /member/reservations/{id} link
Host/staff auth only binds booking ownership or staff role — not invitee membership
attack_path: Entry A (no prior vuln): POST /api/auth/register mode=setup → club admin; POST /api/admin/users create a member in that club; POST /api/admin/bookings with invites[{email:victim@...}] OR login as that member and POST /api/bookings/[id]/invites
Entry B (uses known inviteCode leak): join victim club as member → create booking → invite arbitrary emails
Victims (any platform user email or external) receive inbox item + email + push
findings.impact: Cross-user / cross-tenant notification and inbox injection; phishing via club-branded reservation invites.
findings.oracle: Target emails (directory dump known, or arbitrary external); booking id returned to attacker as host/staff
findings.distinct_from: Not the known communities/[id] inviteCode leak itself; not events RSVP. This is bookings invite fan-out lacking community scoping on invitees.

findings.title: Provider messages and /api/contact write ContactMessage to any recipient email without community check
evidence: createContactMessage stores body.recipient with no community membership assertion
DM bridge may throw ChatCommunityScopeError cross-club, but contact row is written first
listContactMessagesForProviderInbox matches recipient OR sender by email globally
attack_path: 2. POST /api/auth/register mode=provider + communityId (invite-free; known enrollment primitive)
4. Victim provider sees the thread in provider messages inbox
findings.impact: Cross-tenant phishing/spam into provider inboxes without sharing a community.
findings.distinct_from: notifications/send (admin email relay); group message/invite IDORs
